index 4f535f0..7bdd7ca 100644
--- a/base/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh
+++ b/head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh
@@ -49,6 +49,23 @@
 #                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
 #   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
 #   stalls          number of phases that timed out
+#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
+#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
+#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
+#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
+#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
+#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
+#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
+#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
+#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
+#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
+#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
+#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
+#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
+#
+# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
+# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
+# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
 #
 # Usage:
 #   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
@@ -103,7 +120,7 @@ while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
     --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
     --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
     --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
-    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,84p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
+    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,101p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
     *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
   esac
 done
@@ -145,6 +162,12 @@ if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
       // (if ($row.arm | test("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$")) | not then "arm \(.arm) does not match the arm grammar" else empty end)
       // ([("dot_claude_writes", "bash_mount_refs", "mount_changed", "envelope_mismatch") as $k
            | select((($row.zone_violations | objects)[$k] | type) != "array") | "zone_violations.\($k) is not an array"][0])
+      // (if has("defects_missed") and .defects_missed != null
+             and ((.defects_missed | type) != "array"
+                  or any(.defects_missed[]; (type != "string") or (length == 0)))
+           then "field defects_missed has type \(.defects_missed | type), want a list of non-empty strings|null" else empty end)
+      // (if has("regressions_final_green") and ((.regressions_final_green | type) as $ty | ["boolean","null"] | index($ty)) == null
+           then "field regressions_final_green has type \(.regressions_final_green | type), want boolean|null" else empty end)
       // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
       // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
            then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
@@ -384,6 +407,11 @@ ROW="$(jq -n -c \
                                else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .audit), null) | boolish end),
       regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
                                             elif type == "array" then length else . end),
+      defects_missed: (if ($task.type // $p.task_type // "") != "review-catch" or $rc == null then null
+                       else first(($rc | objects | .missed), null) as $ms
+                       | if ($ms | type) == "array" and all($ms[]; type == "string" and length > 0) then $ms
+                         else null end end),
+      regressions_final_green: first(($g.regressions | objects | .final_green | boolish), null),
       diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
       files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
       cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
diff --git a/base/evals/tests/ablation-row.bats b/head/evals/tests/ablation-row.bats
index 5b222a0..27a1cc3 100644
--- a/base/evals/tests/ablation-row.bats
+++ b/head/evals/tests/ablation-row.bats
@@ -399,3 +399,81 @@ edit_pipe() {  # edit_pipe <run> <jq filter>
   [[ "$output" == *"row build failed for abl-fixture-a1_full-bf-01-t1"* ]]
   [ ! -s "$T/rows.jsonl" ]
 }
+
+# --- row writer 1.2: defects_missed (bd-yz1rd) and regressions_final_green (bd-m0hw7) ---
+edit_grade() {  # edit_grade <run> <jq filter>
+  jq "$2" "$T/runs/$1/grade.json" > "$T/g.json" && mv "$T/g.json" "$T/runs/$1/grade.json"
+}
+
+@test "defects_missed: a review-catch row copies recall.missed; regressions_final_green is null" {
+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall.missed = ["d2","d5"]'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(jq -c '[.defects_missed, .regressions_final_green]' <<<"$(last)")" = '[["d2","d5"],null]' ]
+}
+
+@test "defects_missed: an empty recall.missed is [], an absent one or a null recall is null" {
+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall.missed = []'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.defects_missed' <<<"$(last)")" = '[]' ]
+  edit_grade a3-review 'del(.recall.missed)'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.defects_missed' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]
+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall = null'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.defects_missed' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]
+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall = {defects_seeded: 3, missed: "d2"}'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.defects_missed' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]
+}
+
+@test "regressions_final_green: a build row copies regressions.final_green (true, false); defects_missed is null" {
+  edit_grade a1-build '.regressions.final_green = true | .recall = {missed: ["d1"]}'
+  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(jq -c '[.regressions_final_green, .defects_missed]' <<<"$(last)")" = '[true,null]' ]
+  edit_grade a1-build '.regressions.final_green = false'
+  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '[.regressions_final_green, .defects_missed]' <<<"$(last)")" = '[false,null]' ]
+  edit_grade a1-build '.regressions.final_green = "yes"'
+  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.regressions_final_green' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]
+  edit_grade a1-build '.regressions = null'
+  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.regressions_final_green' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "an ungraded run has defects_missed and regressions_final_green null" {
+  [ ! -f "$T/runs/a1-review/grade.json" ]
+  row a1-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  row a5-build "$BUILD_TASK"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl" --allow-ungraded
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(jq -s -c 'map([has("defects_missed"), .defects_missed, has("regressions_final_green"), .regressions_final_green])' "$T/rows.jsonl")" = '[[true,null,true,null],[true,null,true,null]]' ]
+}
+
+@test "--validate: defects_missed must be a list of non-empty strings or null, regressions_final_green a boolean or null; a legacy row lacking both keys validates" {
+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall.missed = ["d2"]'
+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  local good; good="$(last)"
+  jq -c '.defects_missed = "d2"' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"one.jsonl:1: field defects_missed has type string"* ]]
+  jq -c '.defects_missed = ["d2", 3]' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"field defects_missed has type array"* ]]
+  jq -c '.defects_missed = [""]' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  jq -c '.regressions_final_green = "yes"' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"field regressions_final_green has type string, want boolean|null"* ]]
+  { jq -c '.defects_missed = null | .regressions_final_green = true' <<<"$good"
+    jq -c 'del(.defects_missed) | del(.regressions_final_green)' <<<"$good"; } > "$T/two.jsonl"
+  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/two.jsonl"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [[ "$output" == *"2 rows valid"* ]]
+}

+edit_grade() {  # edit_grade <run> <jq filter>

+  edit_grade a3-review '.recall = null'

+  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
+  [ "$(jq -c '.defects_missed' <<<"$(last)")" = 'null' ]

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
#
# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the full reports once against the
# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml. AR-23 … AR-30 (Sprint 262): the suite_version
# partition, the not-testable / not-yet-decidable states (bd-wqbz3), the degradation guard on
# the H1 and A4 lines, and the degenerate single-task rate-fallback pair. AR-31 … AR-35 (Sprint 262
# R3, presentation only): the sensitivity H1/A4 lines, the batch record, precision and cost per true
# defect, the budget-matched baseline.
# =============================================================================

setup_file() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  export REPO_ROOT
  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
  mkdir -p "$FX"
  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
  for s in main boundary exclusions versions degraded degraded-a4 degenerate-1 degenerate-2 degenerate-ids present; do
    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
  done
}

setup() {
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | $3" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

cmp_of() {  # cmp_of <scenario> <arm> <metric> <jq path under the comparison>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    --out "$o.md" --json "$o.json" "$@"
}

@test "AR-1 each rule branch on planted rows: -0.05 tight Keep, 0.00 at -20 % cost Remove, 0.00 similar cost Simplify, wide Inconclusive, +0.04 Investigate" {
  [ "$(dec main a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "keep" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.05" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi < 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice '.c == -20')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]

head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:861 — [MEDIUM] The default primary suite_version is the highest version any row holds, counting rows that never enter a decision (smoke batches, rows with no manifest, rows on arms the suite doesn't run). Reproduced: I moved the main fixture's smoke-260 batch to suite_version 2. Its decided priority-1 rows (suite_version 1, H1 established) dropped out of the main sections. H1 then read "not yet decidable (no pair)", every decision read "no rows", and `--partial` exited 1. So one smoke batch run ahead of a model bump silently takes over Decisions, H1/A4 and the exit code. Pick the primary from versions that have decidable (non-listed) rows, or at least warn when the primary has none.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:549 — [MEDIUM] defect_vector reads any list of strings as per-defect ids and keys only `d1…dN`. An id in any other form (`D1`, `defect-1`, `1`, or past N) is silently counted as caught, and nothing checks the vector against the row's own defects_caught / defect_catch_rate. This matters now because row writer 1.2 fills defects_missed on every graded review-catch row, which moves the catch-rate comparisons from "rate" to "ids" mode. Reproduced on the `versions` fixture by upper-casing a0_bare's ids (each row still says caught 6/8, rate 0.75): catch d went from +0.444 to 0 and H1 flipped from "established" to "not established — halt before promotion". Reject or flag ids that don't match `^d[1-9][0-9]*$` and ≤ N, and fall back to the rate (or fail) when the count disagrees with defects_caught.
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:413 — [MEDIUM] The writer keeps any non-empty string as a missed-defect id, and `--validate` (lines 165-168) accepts the same. Neither checks the dK grammar that ablation-report.py's defect_vector depends on, or that `defects_seeded − |missed| == defects_caught`. A grader-format drift therefore passes both tools and silently changes the H1 catch-rate figure (see the ablation-report.py:549 finding). Validate the id form and the count here, where grade.json is at hand.
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:414 — [LOW] regressions_final_green isn't gated on task type, unlike defects_missed at line 410. The header (lines 57-60) says it is null on review-catch rows, but that only holds if the grader never writes a `regressions` object for review-catch tasks. Gate it on the task type, or correct the doc. No test covers a review-catch grade.json that has `regressions.final_green`.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1065 — [LOW] The batch-record grader tally counts every `<task>-t<n>` and `<task>-t<n>-r<k>` directory that matches a row's trial, so one row with superseded rerun attempts contributes several grader versions. Reproduced: adding `a0_bare/rc-01-t1-r1/grade.json` to the `present` fixture raised the pr-2 tally from 3 to 4 entries with trials_rowed unchanged, including a grader version no row was graded with. Map each row to its own run directory (by run_id or the highest -r<k>), not to all of them.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1054 — [LOW] `os.path.join(d, r["arm"])` uses the row's arm unchecked; load_rows checks only that arm is a non-empty string, and batch_record runs over every row, listed ones included. An absolute arm (`/x`) or one with `..` sends the listdir/grade.json reads outside the batch directory, despite the docstring's "beside its MANIFEST.json". Check the arm against the arm grammar (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`) or the suite's arm ids before building the path.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:835 — [LOW] version_key treats `2`, `2.0` and `"2"` as one version but `"2.0"` (a string) as a separate one. Rows that differ only in how suite_version is serialized are therefore partitioned apart, and `--suite-version 2.0` does not match rows holding 2.0. This contradicts the docstring ("1, 1.0 and \"1\" are one version"). Normalize integral decimal strings as well.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

**Medium**
- **A smoke batch can take over the report** (`ablation-report.py:861`). By default the main sections use the highest suite_version present, even if that version's only rows are ones that never enter a decision. I moved the smoke batch to version 2. H1 then went from "established" to "not yet decidable", every decision read "no rows", and `--partial` exited 1. The real, decided version-1 rows were pushed into a side section.
- **Missed-defect ids are not checked** (`ablation-report.py:549`). The report only recognises ids of the form `d1`…`dN`. Any other id is silently counted as caught, and nothing compares the result with the row's own caught count. This matters more now that the row writer fills `defects_missed` on every graded review-catch row. Upper-casing a0_bare's ids in one fixture moved the catch-rate difference from +0.444 to 0 and flipped H1 to "not established — halt before promotion". The rows still said 6 of 8 caught.
- **The row writer has the same gap** (`ablation-row.sh:413`). Both it and `--validate` accept any non-empty string as an id, with no format or count check, so a change in the grader's id format would pass both tools.

**Low**
- `regressions_final_green` isn't limited to build rows, though the header says it is null on review-catch rows (`ablation-row.sh:414`).
- The grader-version tally counts every rerun directory for a trial, so one row can add several entries (confirmed with an extra `-r1` directory).
- The row's arm is used unchecked in a filesystem path, so reads can leave the batch directory.
- A suite_version written as the string `"2.0"` is treated as a different version from `2`.
